method: Actual captured states with explicit entry, action and resulting behaviour. Native operating-system pickers are described, not fabricated screenshots.

states.title: Version-specific changes
states.entry: Launch an updated version, or choose What’s new in About.
states.action: Read the short change list and testing prompts; choose Done.
states.result: The notice is version-specific and does not edit financial data.

states.title: Feedback technical context and explicit send
states.entry: Choose Send feedback from About.
states.action: Read the no-real-statements warning and technical context, then explicitly open email.
states.result: Only feedback chosen by the user leaves the app. The technical context excludes financial records.

states.title: Self Assessment property summary
states.entry: Open the property tax summary within Reports.
states.action: Select a UK tax year, choose allowable expenses and inspect the income/cost/net summary.
states.result: The user chooses allowable categories for their circumstances. The screen explicitly does not provide tax advice.

states.title: Home after confirming all demo account transfers
states.entry: Use the fully covered synthetic account scenario.
states.action: Read cash, card debt and net worth, then inspect the selected month and history.
states.result: Verified balance context remains explicit; saved pots are included in cash rather than added again.

states.title: Unknown converted figures show rates needed
states.entry: Open a mixed-currency workspace without a required rate.
states.action: Review original account amounts or obtain a rate in Settings.
states.result: Converted figures show Rates needed or Unavailable; missing conversion is never represented as zero.

states.title: Forecast with missing exchange rates
states.entry: Open Forecast with a missing account-currency rate.
states.action: Use Import recent statements or Currency settings to resolve the missing basis.
states.result: The projected total remains unavailable instead of presenting an unsupported estimate.

states.title: First-launch beta notice
states.entry: Open Feng in a fresh browser profile.
states.action: Read the beta, privacy and backup notice; choose demo or import your own statements.
states.result: The next choice opens the local workspace or Files picker. No account or server login is required.

states.title: Home after cancelling first picker
states.entry: Cancel the first file picker or start without records.
states.action: Use Import to choose local PDFs, or explore fictitious demo data.
states.result: Unknown balances stay unavailable until statements exist; empty history is not a zero balance.

states.title: Transactions with no imported records
states.entry: Open Transactions before importing records.
states.action: Use Import or add a deliberate manual record.
states.result: The empty state gives a next action without fabricated rows.

states.title: No recurring evidence yet
states.entry: Open recurring review without sufficient transaction history.
states.action: Import more history or return to the main workflow.
states.result: No subscription is invented without evidence.

states.title: No goals or pots yet
states.entry: Open Pots before creating goals.
states.action: Choose the create action when ready.
states.result: The empty state explains the purpose rather than displaying fictional progress.

states.title: No saved backup yet
states.entry: Open backup settings before saving any backup.
states.action: Choose Save backup.
states.result: The status says no backup has been saved rather than inventing a last-saved date.

states.title: Transaction filters sheet
states.entry: Choose Filters in Transactions.
states.action: Set account, category, type, amount bounds or review status.
states.result: The footer reports matching transactions and applies the view without editing financial records.

states.title: Explicit date-range filters
states.entry: Choose Date range in Filters.
states.action: Enter From and To as DD/MM/YYYY or use each calendar action.
states.result: A complete valid range filters the list; invalid drafts never silently reuse a previous date.

states.title: Advanced condition builder
states.entry: Choose Build a filter or show conditions.
states.action: Combine the existing condition fields and operators; inspect the matching count.
states.result: The query changes a saved/view filter, not the original transaction data.

states.title: Search has no results and can be cleared
states.entry: Search for a value absent from the synthetic records.
states.action: Clear the search or change filters.
states.result: The empty result is distinct from an empty database.

states.title: Uncategorised-only queue
states.entry: Select Uncategorised from Home or transaction prefilters.
states.action: Start sorting, tap a row, or drag its object on desktop.
states.result: The all-dates queue removes a transaction as soon as its category is saved; Undo restores it.

states.title: Sorting sheet with suggested categories
states.entry: Open sorting for an uncategorised transaction.
states.action: Drop the transaction on a category object, or tap a suggested tile. Search all categories when suggestions do not fit.
states.result: The choice saves immediately and becomes a matching default for the same account and money direction.

states.title: Learning receipt and next transaction
states.entry: Choose a category while sorting.
states.action: Read the learning receipt; use Undo to reverse the category and its learned default.
states.result: The next transaction is ready. The toast remains clear of Skip and the transaction-detail footer.

states.title: Transaction detail and source trace
states.entry: Select a transaction row.
states.action: Inspect the amount and source; change category/type/name or open Split, Tags or attachments.
states.result: Category/type/tag edits save immediately with Undo. Manual categorisation learns its future default automatically.

states.title: Split editor with remaining allocation
states.entry: Open Split from a purchase detail.
states.action: Allocate amounts and a category to each line.
states.result: Save stays disabled while a remainder or missing required category exists; the original ledger amount stays unchanged.

states.title: Split editor balanced to the source amount
states.entry: Complete both split categories and allocate exactly the original purchase amount.
states.action: Check Remaining is zero, then Save split.
states.result: The allocation changes category analysis while preserving the original statement amount and reconciliation.

states.title: Refund source and counted month
states.entry: Open a positive transaction linked as a refund.
states.action: Inspect which original purchase month receives the reduction; use Refund of to correct the link.
states.result: Refunds reduce original spending, including closed months, rather than inflating income.

states.title: Refund same-merchant recent-purchase picker
states.entry: Choose Refund of from the refund detail.
states.action: Select a likely recent purchase from the same merchant, check the allocation, or Search all purchases.
states.result: Link refund is enabled when the amount is allocated. The arrival date stays visible separately from the original spending month.

states.title: Manual transaction bottom sheet
states.entry: Choose Add manual transaction.
states.action: Select account, UK date, description, direction, amount and category; complete any optional note.
states.result: Save records the signed amount locally. Later matching statement rows can replace the manual entry without counting it twice.

states.title: Rule editor with live matching preview
states.entry: Choose Create rule or edit a rule from Settings.
states.action: Name it, define match conditions and actions, and inspect the matching-count preview.
states.result: Explicit rules are prioritised; Save applies the existing local rule engine and offers a reversible receipt.

states.title: Add category sheet
states.entry: Choose Add category in Settings.
states.action: Enter name, parent, financial kind and preset colour.
states.result: Save creates a local category without changing imported amounts.

states.title: Edit category sheet
states.entry: Select an existing category.
states.action: Edit its name or colour, or use the visually separated Archive action.
states.result: Existing parent and financial role are preserved by the owner-approved scope decision.

states.title: Add bank account sheet
states.entry: Choose Add bank account from Accounts.
states.action: Enter nickname, institution, type, mask, currency and net-worth inclusion.
states.result: Save creates the local account; no API login or credential upload occurs.

states.title: Manual asset or liability sheet
states.entry: Choose Add account in Assets and liabilities.
states.action: Enter asset/liability type, UK valuation date, amount and any reminder interval.
states.result: The dated valuation affects net worth, not income/spending; stale values are labelled.

states.title: Budget edit sheet
states.entry: Select a budget category.
states.action: Enter its monthly amount and carry setting, then save.
states.result: The budget changes, while actual transactions remain unchanged.

states.title: Goal or irregular-cost pot sheet
states.entry: Choose a pot or create one.
states.action: Enter its type, target, UK due date and tracking method.
states.result: Save records the goal or irregular-cost plan locally.

states.title: Pot contribution and separated destructive options
states.entry: Open a pot’s options.
states.action: Record a contribution or use the separated destructive option if it is no longer needed.
states.result: Reversible changes produce Undo; account cash is not counted twice.

states.title: Recurring payment series edit sheet
states.entry: Open an expected payment series from Calendar.
states.action: Set account, cadence, direction, expected amount, next date and optional end date.
states.result: Confirm series stores an estimate separately from imported paid transactions.

states.title: APR and actual minimum payment terms
states.entry: Choose repayment terms on a debt account.
states.action: Enter the actual APR and monthly minimum/payment inputs.
states.result: Validated terms enable an eligible payoff estimate; mortgage terms are not guessed.

states.title: Repayment strategy and amount sheet
states.entry: Open the debt plan editor.
states.action: Choose the existing repayment strategy and planned amount.
states.result: Save changes planning inputs with Undo, without changing statement balances.

states.title: What-if adjustments separate from actual figures
states.entry: Scroll to What if within Forecast.
states.action: Compare the baseline preview and use Edit scenario for temporary changes.
states.result: Scenario values are separate from the actual ledger; an empty scenario does not pretend to have saved changes.

states.title: Reports scope and condition edit sheet
states.entry: Choose Edit report from a result.
states.action: Change report name, grouping, measure, tax year or filters.
states.result: View report previews the result; Save report persists the selected report definition locally.

states.title: Processing one selected PDF
states.entry: Select a supported digital PDF.
states.action: Wait while the local reader detects the bank and checks the statement.
states.result: The file remains on the device. Progress leads to a single combined review; this is not a manual mapping step.

states.title: Native bank one-statement review
states.entry: Finish local reading of one supported-bank statement.
states.action: Check the detected account, period and status; expand the statement if more detail is needed.
states.result: Nothing is saved until Confirm import. Reconciled supported layouts avoid unnecessary row-by-row verification.

states.title: Native statement figures and exact reconciliation
states.entry: Expand the detected statement in review.
states.action: Compare opening balance, Money in, Money out, closing balance and difference with the PDF.
states.result: Statement movements include transfers and card repayments. Dashboard income and spending exclude confirmed internal transfers.

states.title: Four native bank statements in one review
states.entry: Select Barclays current account, Barclaycard, Amex and Revolut synthetic files together.
states.action: Review all four detected statements in one place, correcting only exceptions.
states.result: One confirmation imports the selected valid rows and returns Home.

states.title: Import completion with next action
states.entry: Confirm the combined import.
states.action: Read the imported count, then choose Sort now if transactions need a category.
states.result: Home updates immediately and gives a clear next action. Income/spending retain coverage qualifications.

states.title: Post-import storage warning state
states.entry: Use Feng in a Safari tab after importing.
states.action: Read any storage or installation guidance and save a portable backup before moving to the installed app.
states.result: Tab and installed storage should not be assumed shared; the screenshot records the actual conditional state.

states.title: Exact duplicate statement is skipped
states.entry: Select an already imported PDF.
states.action: Read the exact-file duplicate status and review the selected rows.
states.result: The duplicate is skipped by default; overriding it is explicit.

states.title: Unfamiliar bank generic reader
states.entry: Select an unfamiliar-bank statement.
states.action: Review the generic reader’s source proof and suggested structure.
states.result: The generic route is reserved for unsupported layouts; it does not replace supported-bank detection.

states.title: Column role mapping exception workflow
states.entry: Open mapping when the generic reader cannot determine column roles safely.
states.action: Assign the visible date, description and amount/balance roles against the source preview.
states.result: The app recalculates extracted rows and reconciliation before import; mapping is an exception workflow.

states.title: Synthetic T11 amount mismatch blocks confirmation
states.entry: Import synthetic T11 with an incorrect amount.
states.action: Compare its discrepancy and source evidence; correct or exclude the problem row.
states.result: Confirmation is blocked while unresolved validation requirements remain.

states.title: Needs review list with extracted rows and source proof
states.entry: Open Needs review for the malformed synthetic statement.
states.action: Inspect highlighted rows against the original page crop.
states.result: Corrections recheck statement proof immediately. No transaction is silently discarded.

states.title: Problem row correction with source crop
states.entry: Choose the highlighted statement row.
states.action: Compare extracted date, description, amount and balance with its source before correcting.
states.result: Reconciliation updates immediately; valid selected rows remain visible.

states.title: Damaged or unsupported PDF error
states.entry: Select the damaged/unsupported synthetic PDF.
states.action: Read the actionable error and retry another file.
states.result: No partial financial database write occurs.

states.title: Default password-protected backup sheet
states.entry: Choose Save backup.
states.action: Keep password protection on; enter and confirm a password and choose attachment inclusion.
states.result: The file is encrypted locally; passwords are not recoverable by the developer.

states.title: Protected backup ready for export
states.entry: Complete both valid backup password fields.
states.action: Save backup and use Files to retain the downloaded file.
states.result: The named file contains the complete portable dataset and selected attachments.

states.title: Backup download receipt
states.entry: Finish creating a backup download.
states.action: Read the dated file receipt and save it in Files.
states.result: A browser download receipt does not itself prove the user has retained the file.

states.title: Encrypted backup password gate
states.entry: Choose Restore and a protected Feng file.
states.action: Enter its password and choose Unlock and preview.
states.result: Current records remain unchanged until a later explicit replacement acknowledgement.

states.title: Wrong password cannot change financial data
states.entry: Submit the synthetic backup with an incorrect password.
states.action: Read the wrong-password/damaged-file error and retry or cancel.
states.result: No current records are changed.

states.title: Restore contents preview before acknowledgement
states.entry: Unlock a valid backup or select a supported readable backup.
states.action: Inspect account/transaction/statement/rule counts, dates and details; back up current data first if needed.
states.result: Replacement remains disabled until acknowledgement.

states.title: Explicit replacement acknowledgement
states.entry: Check the replacement acknowledgement after preview.
states.action: Use Replace data with backup, or Cancel restore.
states.result: Replacement is transactional; it does not merge unknown schemas or partially overwrite the database.

states.title: Optional readable backup warning
states.entry: Turn off password protection in the backup sheet.
states.action: Read that the file contains readable financial data before saving.
states.result: Readable backup remains an explicit option with its privacy warning.

states.title: Invalid backup rejected without replacing data
states.entry: Select an invalid or unsupported newer backup.
states.action: Read the schema/version error and select a supported backup.
states.result: The existing workspace remains intact.

states.title: Both delete options disabled without acknowledgement
states.entry: Open the danger section without accepting its warnings.
states.action: Read the separate record deletion and full-erasure consequences.
states.result: Both destructive actions are disabled initially.

states.title: Record-only deletion acknowledgement
states.entry: Acknowledge deleting imported records.
states.action: Confirm the record-only action if intended.
states.result: Learned categories/rules remain available for a clean reimport test; this differs from full erasure.

states.title: Full-erasure exact phrase gate
states.entry: Read full-erasure consequences and type ERASE exactly.
states.action: Confirm only after retaining any needed backup.
states.result: Full local erasure is intentionally irreversible; the exact-phrase gate is distinct from routine Undo.

states.title: PIN protection configured
states.entry: Finish configuring the synthetic PIN.
states.action: Inspect enabled protection and lock-delay context.
states.result: Credential changes remain confirmed and private; no credential history is added.

states.title: Locked workspace with six masked digits
states.entry: Lock or reopen the protected test workspace.
states.action: Enter the six-digit PIN or use a supported configured platform authenticator.
states.result: The workspace remains hidden until authentication succeeds.

states.title: Incorrect PIN stays locked
states.entry: Enter an incorrect PIN in the isolated test workspace.
states.action: Read the error and retry through the masked keypad.
states.result: The workspace stays locked; a wrong PIN does not reveal data.

states.title: Forgot PIN explanation without recovery promises
states.entry: Choose Forgot PIN from the lock screen.
states.action: Read the backup-only recovery explanation.
states.result: There is no developer reset or invented remote recovery service.

states.title: Actual schema migration previous-data safety copy
states.entry: Open previous-data recovery after an actual synthetic schema upgrade.
states.action: Inspect the dated local safety snapshot and expiry context.
states.result: This is local migration recovery, separate from portable backup.

states.title: Safety copy replacement warning and preserved security
states.entry: Request restoring the previous-data safety copy.
states.action: Read which later edits will be replaced before confirming.
states.result: The snapshot restores prior records and security consistently while keeping the additive database schema.

states.title: Home with full demo and qualified values
states.entry: Open Home with incomplete demo statement coverage.
states.action: Choose the month, inspect cash and card debt, then use account or category objects for detail.
states.result: Partial, stale and missing balances are labelled. Net worth is withheld when required information is missing.

states.title: Transactions list
states.entry: Choose Activity on mobile or Transactions on desktop.
states.action: Search, select an account, use the limited prefilters or open Filters. Select a row for its source and edits.
states.result: The list preserves signed amounts and category status. Account chips provide compact balance context.

states.title: Analyse overview
states.entry: Choose Analyse.
states.action: Read income, expenses and net cash flow before charts; choose a range or a category.
states.result: Transfers are excluded. Partial coverage and approximate conversion are visible beside the figures.

states.title: Property report
states.entry: Open the dedicated property report.
states.action: Choose month/range, review rental income, costs and net cash flow, then inspect monthly values.
states.result: It is a cash-flow report with source and coverage qualifications, not a tax or profitability guarantee.

states.title: Reports result
states.entry: Open Reports from Analyse.
states.action: Read the current result; change table/bar/line or use Edit report to change the scope.
states.result: Results appear before the editor, and category rows open supporting transactions.

states.title: Tags and trips analysis
states.entry: Open Tags and trips from Analyse.
states.action: Select a tag to review the associated spending and source transactions.
states.result: Tags provide additional grouping without changing original financial amounts.

states.title: Subscriptions and bills
states.entry: Open Subscriptions and bills from the relevant Home/Planning entry.
states.action: Review recurring candidates, changes in price, and whether to keep or plan cancellation.
states.result: Recurring evidence is a suggestion, not proof of a subscription or confirmation that a provider has cancelled it.

states.title: Monthly budgets
states.entry: Open Planning, then Budgets.
states.action: Read budget status before editing; choose the category object to set or amend a budget.
states.result: Imported spending remains separate from the planned limit and any carry amount.

states.title: Pots and goals
states.entry: Open Planning, then Pots.
states.action: Inspect progress towards goals or irregular costs; open a pot for editing or contribution options.
states.result: Set-aside money is already included in cash and is not an additional account balance.

states.title: Payments calendar
states.entry: Open Planning, then Calendar.
states.action: Review filled imported payments and outlined expected payments; inspect possible recurring matches.
states.result: Expected dates and amounts are estimates. Similar bills remain separate until the user confirms they are the same.

states.title: Debt payoff summary
states.entry: Open Planning, then Debt.
states.action: Read the payoff summary and assumptions; open repayment terms or strategy to change inputs.
states.result: Loans and mortgages require actual monthly payment terms before inclusion; a mortgage balance alone is not treated as card debt.

states.title: Forecast summary
states.entry: Open Planning, then Forecast.
states.action: Choose the horizon and inspect the projected total, upcoming payments and what-if preview.
states.result: Forecasts are labelled estimates based on available verified balances and history; they do not edit actual finances.

states.title: Grouped Settings
states.entry: Open Settings, then home.
states.action: Choose one of the grouped destinations.
states.result: Groups separate data management, preferences, privacy/storage and About.

states.title: Bank/card accounts and manual assets
states.entry: Open Accounts from Home or Transactions.
states.action: Read institution, nickname, account type, currency, dated balance and verification state; select a row to edit.
states.result: Credit-card balances are shown as debt owed. Manual assets and liabilities remain distinct from cash flow.

states.title: Import picker fallback
states.entry: Open Import from navigation, or return after cancelling Files.
states.action: Select one or several PDF statements from the native file picker.
states.result: Normal Home and navigation imports open Files directly. This page is the cancellation/retry fallback.

states.title: Settings: appearance
states.entry: Open Settings, then appearance.
states.action: Choose System, Light or Dark.
states.result: System is the unset default; explicit choices persist and have Undo.

states.title: Settings: currency
states.entry: Open Settings, then currency.
states.action: Choose the reporting currency or manage public/manual rates.
states.result: Original transaction currencies remain traceable; missing rates never become zero.

states.title: Settings: period
states.entry: Open Settings, then period.
states.action: Choose calendar, fixed-day or payday-driven month boundaries.
states.result: The existing period validation remains in force.

states.title: Settings: categories
states.entry: Open Settings, then categories.
states.action: Select a category to edit, or add one.
states.result: Parent changes for existing categories remain outside this approved pass.

states.title: Settings: rules
states.entry: Open Settings, then rules.
states.action: Create a rule or import/export personal rules.
states.result: Every manual category choice already learns automatically; a second Remember action is not required.

states.title: Settings: tags
states.entry: Open Settings, then tags.
states.action: Open a tag object or create a named tag with a preset colour.
states.result: Tags group transactions without changing amounts.

states.title: Settings: reminders
states.entry: Open Settings, then reminders.
states.action: Configure the existing statement and backup reminders.
states.result: The PWA shows local reminders; web notification availability depends on browser/platform permission.

states.title: Settings: reports
states.entry: Open Settings, then reports.
states.action: Manage saved report definitions.
states.result: Editing the definition affects the view, not the original financial records.

states.title: Settings: transfers
states.entry: Open Settings, then transfers.
states.action: Review matching mode and date window.
states.result: Manual confirmation remains the default; suggested pairs are not silently confirmed.

states.title: Settings: security
states.entry: Open Settings, then security.
states.action: Configure six-digit PIN or supported platform authentication and lock delay.
states.result: The screen explains that the app lock does not encrypt IndexedDB. Credential changes are confirmed; credential Undo awaits an owner decision.

states.title: Settings: backup
states.entry: Open Settings, then backup.
states.action: Choose Save backup or Restore.
states.result: Password protection is the default. Both protected and legacy readable formats enter a preview before replacement.

states.title: Settings: storage
states.entry: Open Settings, then storage.
states.action: Review browser persistence information and request protected storage where supported.
states.result: A permission result is reported honestly; a saved backup is still needed.

states.title: Settings: export
states.entry: Open Settings, then export.
states.action: Choose the current transaction CSV export.
states.result: CSV is portability output, separate from a full restorable backup.

states.title: Settings: changes
states.entry: Open Settings, then changes.
states.action: Inspect recent changes and their affected-record count.
states.result: Undo reverses eligible local mutations rather than recalculating source statement amounts.

states.title: Settings: demo
states.entry: Open Settings, then demo.
states.action: Confirm removal of fictitious demo records or load a demonstration.
states.result: Deleting demo is separate from deleting real imported records and offers Undo.

states.title: Settings: imports
states.entry: Open Settings, then imports.
states.action: Review locally remembered generic layouts.
states.result: Supported-bank adapters retain their direct route; layout memory supports unfamiliar statement formats.

states.title: Settings: diagnostics
states.entry: Open Settings, then diagnostics.
states.action: Review optional local extraction diagnostics.
states.result: Raw retention is off by default and turning it off clears retained diagnostics; shared diagnostics use placeholders.

states.title: Settings: statements
states.entry: Open Settings, then statements.
states.action: Expand a month, then a statement.
states.result: Rows identify bank, account nickname, transaction count and reconciliation; original PDFs are not retained by default.

states.title: Settings: about
states.entry: Open Settings, then about.
states.action: Inspect version/build, What’s new, feedback, install help and privacy.
states.result: Technical details remain separate from financial records.

states.title: Settings: danger
states.entry: Open Settings, then danger.
states.action: Choose record-only deletion or full erasure, then read the required acknowledgement.
states.result: Record deletion preserves learned configuration; full erasure requires the exact ERASE phrase.

states.title: Monthly review step 1
states.entry: Choose Review month from Analyse.
states.action: Read the selected month totals and comparison basis; continue to the next step.
states.result: Step 1 of 4 explains the month before asking for any categorisation.

states.title: Monthly review step 2
states.entry: Continue to What changed.
states.action: Inspect the largest category changes and coverage labels; open source categories if needed.
states.result: Unavailable comparisons read Not comparable rather than a misleading percentage.

states.title: Monthly review step 3
states.entry: Continue to Pots and goals.
states.action: Inspect dated contribution suggestions; choose a pot row to confirm a contribution or open Manage pots.
states.result: Linked-account pots show their source balance instead of a manual contribution. Earmarked progress does not reduce account cash.

states.title: Monthly review step 4
states.entry: Continue to Housekeeping.
states.action: Review learned rules and backup freshness. Close the month only when all required review and verified coverage conditions are met.
states.result: The final step clearly explains outstanding work; saving a backup and closing a month remain separate actions.

states.title: Install instructions disclosure
states.entry: Expand Install help in About.
states.action: Follow Safari Share → Add to Home Screen on iPhone, or the desktop browser’s install path.
states.result: Installation uses the existing PWA and static assets; there is no App Store onboarding.

states.title: Privacy disclosure
states.entry: Expand Privacy in About.
states.action: Read local processing, optional public rates, feedback and browser-storage limits.
states.result: The screen explains backups and the distinction between an app lock and database encryption.

states.title: Manual exchange-rate entry
states.entry: Choose Enter a manual rate in Currency settings.
states.action: Select currencies, enter the UK date and public conversion value, then save.
states.result: The original ledger currencies and amounts are preserved; the quote supports reporting conversion.

states.title: Debt payoff uses card minimums and excludes unpaid mortgage terms
states.entry: Save valid repayment terms and view Debt.
states.action: Read total interest, estimated debt-free date, savings and the monthly schedule.
states.result: The calculation lists assumptions and excludes a mortgage without actual payment terms.

states.title: Explicit unverified import warning
states.entry: Request importing valid selected rows from an unverified statement.
states.action: Read the warning and explicitly acknowledge the unverified figures, or Continue reviewing.
states.result: Unverified status is retained on the account/statement; a failed proof is never relabelled reconciled.

states.title: Only card statement imported: income and cash unknown
states.entry: Import a credit-card statement without cash-account statements.
states.action: Read card debt and use Import for missing accounts.
states.result: Cash and income remain unknown; card repayments are not a source of salary.

states.title: Partial Home with a known missing statement account
states.entry: Open Home when a known account lacks a required statement.
states.action: Inspect the coverage label and import the missing statement.
states.result: The application withholds a misleading complete net-worth total.

states.title: Desktop object drag and category destinations
states.entry: Start dragging a transaction object on desktop.
states.action: Keep dragging to reveal category destinations and drop on the desired tile.
states.result: A successful drop saves once; cancelling or dropping elsewhere makes no change. Tapping and keyboard controls remain available.

states.title: Scenario editor: temporary adjustments
states.entry: Choose Edit scenario.
states.action: Select an adjustment, date, money direction, amount and label, then save the named scenario.
states.result: Only the forecast scenario changes. Done exits the editor; no trial amount becomes an actual balance.

states.title: Configure six-digit PIN protection
states.entry: Enable PIN protection in Security.
states.action: Enter and confirm six numeric digits using the masked slots.
states.result: The local app lock is configured; it is not encryption of the database.

states.title: Backup containing a valid ECB quote outside supported ledger currencies
states.entry: Restore a valid backup containing cached public ECB quotes.
states.action: Inspect its contents and acknowledgement before replacement.
states.result: Valid cached quote codes do not reject an otherwise restorable backup; account-currency support is unchanged.

states.title: Explicit recurring bill identity review; baseline silently combines similar names
states.entry: Open Review possible match from the payment calendar.
states.action: Compare both recurring entries; choose Same bill or Separate bills.
states.result: The decision is stored locally. A payment cannot fulfil two entries explicitly confirmed as separate bills.

states.title: Recurring bill match Undo; baseline has no confirmation to reverse
states.entry: Confirm a recurring-entry identity decision.
states.action: Use the local Undo receipt to reverse it.
states.result: Both the matching decision and affected series grouping are restored atomically; source transactions are unchanged.

states.title: Monthly review contribution form in a sheet
states.entry: Reach the monthly-review contribution section with a synthetic pot.
states.action: Inspect the suggested contribution and its existing progress context.
states.result: Contributions track set-aside progress rather than adding money to account balances.

states.title: Groceries category
states.entry: Choose Groceries from Home or the Analyse category selector.
states.action: Read this month, monthly average, income share and comparison; scroll to the trend and underlying transactions.
states.result: Incomplete periods do not produce an unsupported deviation. Average and standard deviation use qualifying history.

states.title: Property category
states.entry: Choose Property as a category.
states.action: Inspect property spending, average and income share, then the rent/cost/net section.
states.result: The same category-detail pattern is used; property-specific context appears within it.

states.title: Native bank reconciliation: known-bank-amex
states.entry: Select the supported American Express statement and expand its review.
states.action: Compare the identified account, period, movements, opening and closing figures.
states.result: The native adapter is used. Card debt uses a negative ledger balance; reconciled figures show a zero difference. Confirm once for the selected files.

states.title: Native bank reconciliation: known-bank-barclaycard
states.entry: Select the supported Barclaycard statement and expand its review.
states.action: Compare the identified account, period, movements, opening and closing figures.
states.result: The native adapter is used. Card debt uses a negative ledger balance; reconciled figures show a zero difference. Confirm once for the selected files.

states.title: Native bank reconciliation: known-bank-revolut
states.entry: Select the supported Revolut statement and expand its review.
states.action: Compare the identified account, period, movements, opening and closing figures.
states.result: The native adapter is used. Card debt uses a negative ledger balance; reconciled figures show a zero difference. Confirm once for the selected files.

states.title: Category trend comparison and monthly source values
states.entry: Expand Category trends in Analyse.
states.action: Compare qualifying periods and open a category for its plot.
states.result: Incomplete history remains Not comparable; the source matrix can be expanded separately.

states.title: Explicit and remembered rules, match, category, hits and last use
states.entry: Open Settings, then rules populated.
states.action: Inspect match, resulting category, hits and last use; reorder, edit or pause.
states.result: Explicit and Auto rules remain distinguishable; destructive deletion is separated.

states.title: Expanded cash-flow source values
states.entry: Expand View chart values beneath cash flow.
states.action: Read each month’s coverage, income, negative spending and net.
states.result: This is an accessible source table for the same plot, not a second calculation.

states.title: Expanded property cash-flow source values
states.entry: Expand View chart values beneath property cash flow.
states.action: Read the monthly coverage and net values.
states.result: No-data months say No statements rather than showing a zero profit.

states.title: Expanded category monthly source values
states.entry: Expand View values in a category detail.
states.action: Inspect monthly amount and income percentage cards.
states.result: Partial-month cards are labelled; each value supports the plotted trend.

states.title: Expanded category trend source matrix
states.entry: Expand Monthly values under category trends.
states.action: Scroll the table horizontally to inspect all months.
states.result: Amounts stay atomic; partial months are labelled and the page itself does not overflow.

states.title: Report result: bar
states.entry: Switch Reports to Bar.
states.action: Compare category amounts through the graphical row objects and open sources.
states.result: The report uses the same signed values as its table.

states.title: Report result: line
states.entry: Switch Reports to Line.
states.action: Inspect the axis/points and the full source table below.
states.result: Axis labels use theme contrast and readable sizes; this is a visual view of the same report values.

states.title: Populated past-period budget status before editing
states.entry: Open Budgets for a populated past period.
states.action: Read spent, budget, carry and ended/on-track context before opening edit.
states.result: The screen begins with status rather than an empty form.

states.title: Recurring charges and price-change evidence
states.entry: Open a recurring candidate and its charge history.
states.action: Compare dates and amounts; inspect the price-change notice before choosing a status.
states.result: The evidence links to real source transactions in the local workspace. Cancellation still requires action with the provider.

states.title: Tag name and preset colours
states.entry: Create or edit a tag from Settings.
states.action: Enter its name and select a preset colour.
states.result: The selected colour has a visible check; save changes its grouping label without altering amounts.

states.title: Allowable expense choices
states.entry: Choose allowable expenses in the tax summary.
states.action: Check the categories relevant to the user’s circumstances, then View tax summary.
states.result: The report preference saves with Undo. It does not recategorise transactions or assert tax eligibility.

states.title: Transaction tag choices and search
states.entry: Choose Add tag from a transaction.
states.action: Search or choose an existing tag object, then Done.
states.result: The tag changes locally; a concurrent categorisation receipt remains clear of the footer.
